segments.text: Here's how to get 100 million views on social media.
For six months, we ran a version of Sunny that watched TikTok all day and made videos.
It spotted what was about to trend and answered what people were already searching for.
The result was 113 million views. It became one of Marblissom's biggest growth drivers.
Today we're putting that same technology in your hands.
Ask Sunny to make a trending video, he researches, writes and generates it using your face and voice.
